entities.name: Basilique Notre-Dame-de-Lourdes de Nancy
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The Basilica of Notre-Dame de Lourdes in Nancy (Basilique Notre-Dame de Lourdes de Nancy), a 20th-century Catholic basilica in Nancy, Lorraine, France dedicated to the Virgin of Lourdes — representing the Lourdes Marian apparition tradition (1858) that has made Lourdes the most visited pilgrimage site in the world — is one of the several Lourdes-dedicated churches built throughout France and the world as 'proxy Lourdes' pilgrimage and devotional centers for communities unable to travel to the original Lourdes grotto in the Pyrenees.

The apparitions of the Virgin Mary to Bernadette Soubirous at Lourdes in 1858, subsequently confirmed by the Catholic Church as authentic apparitions, made Lourdes the center of one of the most powerful Catholic pilgrimage traditions in modern history. The spring discovered during the apparitions became associated with miraculous cures, and Lourdes grew to receive 6 million pilgrims annually by the 20th century. The devotion to Notre-Dame de Lourdes spread worldwide through replica grottos, dedicated chapels, and basilicas constructed in every country with significant Catholic populations.

Nancy's Notre-Dame de Lourdes basilica belongs to this worldwide network of Lourdes-dedicated sacred spaces. Its construction and dedication reflect the extraordinary impact of the Lourdes apparitions on 19th-20th century French Catholicism — particularly in Lorraine, where Marian devotion was combined with patriotic sentiment (the 1870 defeat, German annexation, and hope for return of Alsace-Lorraine intensified French Catholic Marian piety). The basilica continues to serve Nancy's Catholic community as a Lourdes-affiliated pilgrimage site.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Basilica of Notre-Dame de Lourdes Nancy — one of thousands of Lourdes-dedicated churches worldwide, serving as a local proxy pilgrimage site, and reflecting the extraordinary global impact of the 1858 Lourdes apparitions on Catholic devotion — is locally significant and part of the most widespread Catholic pilgrimage devotion network in modern history.
